Start from each `party_events` record; combine it with each `member` record for which Member ID (`member.Member_ID`) equals Member in charge ID (`party_events.Member_in_charge_ID`), one combined record per match (a record without a match is dropped); combine it with each `party` record for which Party ID (`party.Party_ID`) equals Party ID (`member.Party_ID`) (compared as numbers: the text is read as a number), one combined record per match (a record without a match is dropped); combine it with each `region` record for which Region ID (`region.Region_ID`) equals Region ID (`party.Region_ID`), one combined record per match (a record without a match is dropped); group the kept records by Member in charge ID (`party_events.Member_in_charge_ID`) and release format (`region.Format`); each group gives one result row; for each result row, return (1) Member in charge ID (`party_events.Member_in_charge_ID`); (2) release format (`region.Format`); (3) the number of records in the group.
Step 2. Start from the rows of step 1; all kept records form one group, which gives one result row; for each result row, return (1) the sum of column (3) of step 1 in the group (missing values ignored; missing when there are none).
Step 3. Start from the rows of step 1; combine it with the rows of step 2 for which it is not true that column (1) of step 2 is missing, one combined record per match (a record without a match is dropped); for each kept record, return (1) column (1) of step 1; (2) column (2) of step 1; (3) column (3) of step 1; (4) A ÷ B. Here A is column (3) of step 1; B is column (1) of step 2.
Step 4. Start from the rows of step 3; group the kept records by column (2) of step 3; each group gives one result row; for each result row, return (1) column (2) of step 3; (2) the sum of column (3) of step 3 in the group (missing values ignored; missing when there are none); (3) the average of column (4) of step 3 in the group (missing values ignored; missing when there are none).
Step 5. Start from the rows of step 4; all kept records form one group, which gives one result row; for each result row, return (1) the average of column (3) of step 4 in the group (missing values ignored; missing when there are none).
Step 6. Start from the rows of step 4; combine it with the rows of step 5 for which it is not true that column (1) of step 5 is missing, one combined record per match (a record without a match is dropped); keep only the records for which column (3) of step 4 is greater than column (1) of step 5; for each kept record, return (1) column (1) of step 4; (2) column (2) of step 4; (3) column (3) of step 4; (4) A − B. Here A is column (3) of step 4; B is column (1) of step 5.
Step 7 (the answer). Start from the rows of step 6; all kept records form one group, which gives one result row; for each result row, return (1) the average of column (2) of step 6 in the group (missing values ignored; missing when there are none); (2) the average of column (3) of step 6 in the group (missing values ignored; missing when there are none); (3) the average of column (4) of step 6 in the group (missing values ignored; missing when there are none).

examples.construction: agg:member within region.Label > share:all > agg:g > baseline:all > agg:all
why: share of the all total of number of party_events records (all level)
coarsen to g: AVG (averaged), AVG (averaged)
gap to the all average of average of number of party_events records: share of the all total (all level)
coarsen to all: AVG (averaged), AVG (averaged), AVG (averaged)
examples.sql: WITH "s1" AS (SELECT "party_events"."Member_in_charge_ID" AS e, "region"."Label" AS g, COUNT(*) AS m1 FROM "party_events" JOIN "member" ON "member"."Member_ID" = "party_events"."Member_in_charge_ID" JOIN "party" ON "party"."Party_ID" = "member"."Party_ID" JOIN "region" ON "region"."Region_ID" = "party"."Region_ID" GROUP BY "party_events"."Member_in_charge_ID", "region"."Label"), "s2" AS (SELECT SUM("s1"."m1") AS v FROM "s1"), "s3" AS (SELECT "s1"."e" AS e, "s1"."g" AS g, "s1"."m1" AS m1, (CAST("s1"."m1" AS REAL) / "s2"."v") AS m2 FROM "s1" JOIN "s2" ON "s2"."v" IS NOT NULL), "s4" AS (SELECT "s3"."g" AS g, AVG("s3"."m1") AS m1, AVG("s3"."m2") AS m2 FROM "s3" GROUP BY "s3"."g"), "s5" AS (SELECT AVG("s4"."m2") AS v FROM "s4"), "s6" AS (SELECT "s4"."g" AS g, "s4"."m1" AS m1, "s4"."m2" AS m2, ("s4"."m2" - "s5"."v") AS m3 FROM "s4" JOIN "s5" ON "s5"."v" IS NOT NULL WHERE "s4"."m2" > "s5"."v") SELECT AVG("s6"."m1") AS m1, AVG("s6"."m2") AS m2, AVG("s6"."m3") AS m3 FROM "s6"
